title: Event contract file (contracts/events/<name>.events.json)
description: A component's list of the events it publishes (be-protocol P12.2, P12.3). Additive only: a subject or a payload field is never removed, renamed, retyped or given a new meaning; a breaking change is a new subject version.

envelope.description: Free-form description of the envelope for human readers; the envelope itself is fixed by the protocol (schemas/envelope.schema.json).

x-aggregate-type.description: The declared aggregate type; never parsed out of the subject. All subjects of one aggregate type share one strictly increasing aggregate version.

x-consumption.description: state (default): consumers bring a projection to the state at version v and skip older versions. sequence: reserved, not built in 1.0.

x-transaction-document.description: true when the event is about a transaction document: the payload requires legal_entity_id, the runtime sets ce-legalentity from it, and a consumer dead-letters the event when it is missing (P11.8).

grade.description: core: business-critical (persisted, deduplicated, may reach dead letters); peripheral: informational side events.

note.description: Who consumes it and why, in prose.

payload.description: A JSON Schema (2020-12) for the payload object.

claim_check.description: A claim check for content above 64 KiB (P12.2, P17.3): a payload field of this shape, $ref'd from the event's payload schema as https://github.com/brickKit/be-protocol/schemas/events-contract.schema.json#/$defs/claim_check. A consumer obtains a short-lived URL from the producer's rpc, never from the bucket.

key.description: The object key in the producer's own bucket.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the content, lowercase hex.

size.description: Size of the content in bytes.
